summary: Implemented terminal window title support in Rich. Added ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE (rich/segment.py), an OSC 0 formatter and Control.title() classmethod that strips C0 control characters and DEL from the title (rich/control.py), and Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool which writes only when output is a terminal and not legacy Windows (rich/console.py). Added tests in tests/test_control.py and tests/test_console.py, and a CHANGELOG.md entry under Unreleased/Added. Tests were not run, per instructions. Nothing was committed.
